notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the tnlandforms row (coordinates, elevation, county) and a Forest Lookouts page that gives the name and county. Elevation unit is assumed to be feet (the record converts 311 to 94.8 m); the Amicalola row cross-check supports feet on that list. The name Ambrose is the tnlandforms author's label (GA349, above 73), so the official name is unknown. The GFC number column is blank for this row on the tnlandforms list. No build date, design, staffing, fire, or status found in two WebSearch queries and the cached pages. Suggested next step: Coffee County or Georgia Forestry Commission records for the tower's history and whether it still stands.
